title: Rich typing
scenario: A 64 Ki-unit document with 3 math blocks, 2 diagrams, 2 raster images, 1 SVG, a 200x5 table and a numbered code fence of 2,000 lines; 100 one-character inserts, 10 Enter presses, 50 arrow keys, a 30-step width resize. Proves G12. RichTextEditor, RichMarkdown profile, Subtle presentation, embedded host; each step is one action settled through every owner turn of its preparation. Variant full is the plan's document (65,280 units); default keeps every object and action at 7,936 units, a 250-line fence and a 25-row table. Variants source and multiplier (each with a -full form) lay the same document out through the v0 document layout: Source mode in chunks, and Rich mode without Markdown rendering at line height 1.5 as one whole layout.
drawCalls: counted per step by the counting COM wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: initial preparation of the whole document; image requests completed from the decoded fixtures

phases.name: prose-insert
phases.description: 40 one-character inserts at the end of the first prose paragraph

phases.name: enter
phases.description: 10 Enter presses (new paragraph) at the same caret, above every later block

phases.name: arrow
phases.description: 25 Right then 25 Down arrow keys from that caret

phases.name: seek-fence
phases.description: the caret moves into the middle line of the numbered code fence (SetSelection)

phases.name: fence-insert
phases.description: 30 one-character inserts inside the numbered code fence

phases.name: seek-table
phases.description: the caret moves to the start of the paragraph right after the table (SetSelection)

phases.name: table-insert
phases.description: 30 one-character inserts in the paragraph next to the table

phases.name: resize
phases.description: 30 width steps, each 1/64 of the variant width narrower
